Save plots to files

Source: R/sciPlot.R
save_plots.Rd

Writes the plots of a summarizeSCI() or summarizeByVisitSCI() result, or a single plot such as res$plots$hb, each into its own file.

Usage

save_plots(
  x,
  file_name = NULL,
  file_path = ".",
  format = "png",
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  res = 300
)

Arguments

x

The result of summarizeSCI() or summarizeByVisitSCI() (made with type = "both" or "plot"), or a single plot, e.g. res$plots$hb.

file_name

Name(s) of the files, without extension. Either one name per plot, or a single name that prefixes the variable names when x holds several plots (e.g. "fig" gives fig_hb.png, fig_hb_cat.png). Default is NULL, which names each file after its variable (hb.png).

file_path

Folder to write the files into. Created if it does not exist. Default is the working directory.

format

File format: "png" (the default), "jpeg", "tiff", "pdf" or "svg".

width, height

Size of the plot in inches. Default is 8 by 5.

res

Resolution in dots per inch, for the pixel formats. Default is 300.

Value

The paths of the files, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
save_plots(res)                                   # hb.png, hb_cat.png
save_plots(res, file_name = "fig", file_path = "figures", format = "pdf")
save_plots(res$plots$hb, file_name = "hemoglobin")  # hemoglobin.png
} # }
